problem: The refresh API exposed two native Excel defects: FormulaValue 03 was projected as a missing XLS cache instead of a saved blank string, causing a spurious refresh write; XLS/XLSB calculation mixed worksheet-only names with complete physical tab positions, mislabeling or omitting trailing-sheet formulas and panicking when evaluating the last worksheet after a chart tab. Earlier field-runtime evidence reviews also overlooked the separate bounded File::refresh API.
changes: Project inline BIFF blank-string formula values as CellValue::String("") while keeping unresolved following-STRING values distinct. Preserve the public wire variants FormulaValue::Empty and FormulaCache::Empty, documenting their actual blank-string meaning.

Build calculation metadata from the complete tab catalog for XLS/XLSB/XLSX; retain grid availability separately, preserve physical positions in formula reports and native cache writes, and use the same names for refresh summaries. Non-worksheet cells are refused and private sheet lookup is bounds checked rather than indexing unchecked.

Add seven native operations tests for no-op cache refresh, cross-sheet/tab ordinals, DOC/DOCX/template SEQ updates, DOCX TOC/page policy, workbook cache write-back, external/merge/macro boundaries and PPTX number/date fields. Add one owning-XLS native wire/reader regression and one focused pending-string distinction regression.
Correct refresh API documentation for DOC and all three workbook formats, explicit cache writing, chunked XLS commits and native text-owner limits.

Remove the overbroad doc-038/doc-066/docx-124 boundary reviews and replace them with scoped positive refresh bindings. Keep layout, merge, full Excel and other runtime limits explicit; add current xls-195/xlsx-271/xlsb-338 external-execution reviews. Historical fixture authoring statuses remain unchanged.

review_correction.finding: The earlier worksheet-evaluator refusal tests correctly show that Word files are not worksheets, but do not establish absence of field refresh. File::refresh already supports bounded main-story Word computation and TOC generation. The current matrices and index now describe and test that operation explicitly.
review_correction.unchanged_boundaries: Pagination, complete Word field semantics, mail-merge execution, external providers, RTF/PPT refresh and native PPTX MCE text-edit limits are not inferred to be supported.

api_behavior.xls_cache: FormulaValue/FormulaCache Empty names stay wire-compatible, but public cell values now expose byte1=03 as a saved empty string rather than CellValue::Empty/missing cache. Fresh XLS/XLSB formula authors may store blank-string placeholders; callers should request recalculation when they want a computed result rather than a saved cache.
api_behavior.formula_positions: Formula::sheet() is documented as a zero-based complete-tab position, matching native edit selectors and unified /sheet[n] paths. The public family worksheet-name view keeps its existing filtered XLS/XLSB contract; calculation/refresh no longer uses it to index physical tabs.
api_behavior.refresh: Report-only workbook refresh remains a no-op; write_cache(true) explicitly publishes supported results. One unified operation can contain multiple native XLS chunks. Changed PPTX field text inherits the native text editor markup profile and may refuse unsupported MCE branch selection atomically.

verification_scope.blank_string: Native XLS B18 has FormulaValue bytes 03 00 00 00 00 00 FF FF, no following String record and exact empty-string formula tokens. Eager and positional readers expose a saved String(""). Across XLS/XLSX/XLSB, default evaluation reports Cached and unmodified native values workbooks refresh as exact no-ops.
verification_scope.tab_positions: A leading native chart stays tab zero; all 16 worksheet formulas are visited, fourteen on tab one and two on tab two. Sheet2!B3 correctly computes its Sheet1 reference. Chart-cell targets retain their format-specific typed refusals, and an invalid chart-reference derivative yields no numeric zero.
verification_scope.workbook_writeback: After changing native Sheet1!B2 to 4, default refresh reports stale results without publication. Explicit write-back changes six XLS or five XLSX/XLSB caches at the exact expected locations, including Sheet2!B3. XLS has a converted supported range formula for Sheet2!B4; XLSX/XLSB table references remain unsupported and keep cache 14. Every unowned OPC member remains exact; XLS changes only six Formula cache byte spans, retaining all tokens and other records/streams. Reopen, current-state no-op, forward replay, complete inverse and exact one-target quota failure pass.
verification_scope.word_captions: Native DOC/DOT/DOCX/DOTX captions start with current Figure/Table SEQ caches. Explicit stale-cache derivatives refresh supported results on file-backed Auto and Eager/byte ingress. Unowned CFB streams and package members remain exact; DOCX document XML returns to the original native bytes. Publication uses one commit and file reopen/inverse are checked.
verification_scope.toc: Changing a native heading refreshes its DOCX TOC with existing bookmarks and saved page numbers. Standalone PAGEREF remains NeedsLayout; every byte outside the TOC owner and every other member stays exact. Adding one heading refuses under Require-page policy without mutation, or creates one bookmark/one missing page and marks dirty under Keep. No page layout is calculated.
verification_scope.pptx: Reordered native non-MCE slides refresh two number fields through both ingress routes. An explicitly library-authored datetime1 field on a native non-MCE slide stays NeedsClock without a caller clock and writes 11/7/2026 with one. Other members, file reopen and inverse remain exact. Reordered MCE-bearing slides refuse UnsupportedContent without mutation in both eager/source modes; the test preserves this documented profile rather than bypassing its guard.
verification_scope.inert_inputs: Actual refresh reports all seven native DOC/DOCX merge fields and all three native external-link/dependent formulas unsupported, retaining exact bytes. Native macro tabs remain discoverable but are excluded from worksheet refresh and direct macro-cell evaluation refuses. RTF and binary PPT return the exact no-refresh-adapter error.
verification_scope.limits: No complete Excel dependency/spill/table engine, Word pagination, generic field grammar, external refresh, macro execution, ambient clock, MCE text-edit support, slide playback or fresh Microsoft Office acceptance is claimed. Stale caches, new headings and date fields are explicitly library-authored derivatives of immutable native inputs.

specification_evidence.finding: When fExprO is FFFF, byte1=03 denotes a blank string value; it is distinct from byte1=00, whose value is carried by a following String record. The native B18 bytes demonstrate the distinction.

reproductions.observed: The native XLS blank-string formula reported Origin::Computed instead of Cached; the original refresh probe wrote the already-current workbook.
